title: Caerwyn, the afternoon
summary: Downtime in the market square on the eve of the Assembly, between the granary and the river.

routes.when: The player sets off for the river stairs and the Drowned Rat (or says they're going there now), following the lead.

lead.what: The big man with the bandaged hand, whom Kell saw at a gentleman's elbow by the Purveyor's wagons at noon, went down the river stairs into the Drowned Rat; she followed him there, and means to go back down at dusk (dock gossip says the big men who do night work for gentlemen drink there).
placedWith: Sergeant Kell's own errand (she's going there)
